# mimecast_anti_spoofing_bypass_policy (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast Cloud Gateway anti-spoofing bypass policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_anti_spoofing_bypass_policy" "example" {
  description = "tf-example-anti-spoofing-bypass"
  option      = "enable_bypass"
  from_type   = "email_domain"
  from_domain = "partner.example"
  to_type     = "internal_addresses"
  spf_domains = ["partner.example"]
  enabled     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `from_type` (String) Source target type, such as `everyone`, `internal_addresses`, `external_addresses`, `email_domain`, `profile_group`, `address_attribute_value`, or `individual_email_address`.
- `to_type` (String) Destination target type.

### Optional

- `bidirectional` (Boolean) Whether the policy applies in both directions.
- `definition_id` (String) Definition ID referenced by this policy, when the policy type requires a definition.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled. Defaults are applied by Mimecast when omitted.
- `enforced` (Boolean) Whether policy enforcement is enabled, when supported by the policy type.
- `from_attribute_id` (String) Source address attribute ID when `from_type` is `address_attribute_value`.
- `from_attribute_value` (String) Source address attribute value when `from_type` is `address_attribute_value`.
- `from_date_time` (String) Optional source schedule start/end value accepted by Mimecast.
- `from_domain` (String) Source domain when `from_type` is `email_domain`.
- `from_email_address` (String) Source email address when `from_type` is `individual_email_address`.
- `from_eternal` (Boolean) Whether the source side schedule is eternal.
- `from_group_id` (String) Source profile group ID when `from_type` is `profile_group`.
- `from_part` (String) Which sender part the policy applies to, such as `envelope_from`, `header_from`, or `both`.
- `hostnames` (List of String) Hostnames condition, when supported by anti-spoofing policies.
- `option` (String) Policy action option. Valid values depend on the policy type.
- `override` (Boolean) Whether this policy overrides lower-priority matches, when supported by the policy type.
- `source_ips` (List of String) Source IP ranges in CIDR notation, when supported by the policy type.
- `spf_domains` (List of String) SPF domains condition, when supported by anti-spoofing bypass policies.
- `to_attribute_id` (String) Destination address attribute ID when `to_type` is `address_attribute_value`.
- `to_attribute_value` (String) Destination address attribute value when `to_type` is `address_attribute_value`.
- `to_date_time` (String) Optional destination schedule start/end value accepted by Mimecast.
- `to_domain` (String) Destination domain when `to_type` is `email_domain`.
- `to_email_address` (String) Destination email address when `to_type` is `individual_email_address`.
- `to_eternal` (Boolean) Whether the destination side schedule is eternal.
- `to_group_id` (String) Destination profile group ID when `to_type` is `profile_group`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mimecast policy ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_anti_spoofing_bypass_policy.example policy-id
```
